# P26.11 — Surveillance-legislation depth: OpenStates 50-state keyword claims (SOURCES.10)

Deepens the keyed OpenStates connector from a single narrow `bill_search`
seed into the **bounded 50-state + DC/territory surveillance-legislation
sweep** — keyword-filtered bill queries across all 56 state-classified
jurisdictions (50 states + DC + AS/GU/MP/PR/VI) emitting typed,
evidence-backed claims for matching bills: bill title, status,
jurisdiction, legislative session, and the matched keyword — with the bill
record URL, a locator into the captured page, and the **verbatim** matched
literal as `raw_value` on every claim.

A proposed bill is **never** promoted to a §11.14 `LegalInstrument` claim —
it is proposed law, and no enactment is inferred from identifier, title,
status, latest action, or presence in the index (§3.1).

## What landed

- **`openstates_plan.toml`** (new, versioned `2026.09.18`) — the whole
  query plan as data: the two bounded `/jurisdictions` pages as the
  discovery surface (52/page = the verified v3 max), the
  `primary`/`regular` latest-start **session-window rule** (a called/special
  session never shadows the main session), `per_page = 20` (the verified
  `/bills` bound — 52 is HTTP 400), `sort = latest_action_desc`, the
  `max_queries = 240` hard bound over the 56×4 = 224 generated queries, and
  four reviewed `query_families` OR'd into one bounded `q` per
  jurisdiction.
- **`legislation_vocab.toml`** (new, versioned `2026.09.18`) — 16 reviewed
  terms covering every ticket-named phrase (ALPR, surveillance-technology
  ordinance, facial recognition, drone/unmanned aerial, body-worn camera,
  ShotSpotter/acoustic gunshot, real-time crime, CCTV, automatic traffic
  enforcement, geofence warrant, cell-site simulator/Stingray, data
  broker, predictive policing), the `typed_claim`/`index_only`
  **claim-shape map**, and the Part VIII per-datum `forbidden_tokens`
  guard on emitted literals (suppressed + recorded, never emitted).
- **`accountability.py`** — `discover_more` expands the captured
  jurisdictions index into the bounded per-jurisdiction × per-family
  `bill_search` targets (the query plan riding the target row as data);
  `fetch` sends `X-API-KEY` for every openstates target (env-only, never
  the URL — HG-09); `parse`/`extract` fail closed on error envelopes and
  malformed payloads (`ContentDrift`); `normalize` applies the claim-shape
  map — the **local verbatim scan** is the match of record (the v3 `q`
  search is fuzzy: `facial recognition` returns commemorative
  resolutions). A matched bill emits a `legislative_bill` entity row +
  `bill_external_id`, `bill_identifier`, `bill_title`, `bill_session`,
  `bill_jurisdiction`, `bill_status`, `bill_status_date`, and
  `bill_matched_keyword` claims; unmatched bills keep the P26.4
  `index_only` link unchanged. Per-query `bill_query` and per-jurisdiction
  `jurisdiction_index` non-claim rows record the sweep's honest outcome
  (matched/empty/truncated) on the fetch record's `document_outcomes`.
- **Bill claims carry no `observed_at`** — claim identity is stable record
  content ("the OpenStates record contains this field"), so an unchanged
  record digests identically on any re-run and cross-day dedup works
  inside the key's 250/day window (the atlas optional-`observed_at`
  pattern; SIG-INGEST-003/017). Observation time stays on the capture
  (`retrieved_at`) and evidence; the record's `latest_action_date` stays
  verbatim in `bill_status_date` — it is routinely future-dated
  (scheduled votes) and tripped `claim_observed_not_future` on the first
  hosted run. The sink stamps `observed_unknown_reason` honestly.
- **Rate-limit wiring** — `rate_limit_per_min = 5` on the reviewed
  `api_allowlist.toml` row + target rows; `PoliteFetcher.set_host_delay`
  pins the host floor on the shared `RateLimiter`, **ratchet-up only**
  (robots can demand slower, never lower the pin); `runner.py` serializes
  `bill_query` outcome rows onto `FetchRecord.document_outcomes`. All
  requests stay inside the shared politeness layer — a persistent 429 is
  a recorded disappearance, never bypassed.
- **`accountability_vocab.toml`** → `2026.09.18`, +9 legislative-bill
  predicates in the allowlist, `spdx = "CC0-1.0"`.
- **Fixtures** — the two real captured `/jurisdictions` pages (56 rows)
  committed; the P26.10 Bonfire fixture's third-party credential literals
  scrubbed (the base's `secret_scan` was red — HG-09).

## Verification

**Deterministic — `make check` green** (lint, format, mypy × 231 files,
3274 tests, verify-gen):

- 19 new sweep tests + updated promoted-source + net tests: plan bounds
  (per_page ≤ 20, max_queries, session classes), 56-jurisdiction coverage,
  TX `89R` (never called `892`), AS/MP session-less, per-family URLs, local
  verbatim matching, typed claims with `Locator.row`/byte-range locators +
  bill-record evidence + verbatim `raw_value`, never a `LegalInstrument`,
  `index_only` fallback, outcome rows, fail-closed envelopes, Part VIII
  suppression, digest stability, pinned-budget ratchet semantics.

**Live — hosted `sig-ingest-openstates` on the rebuilt image**
(`sig-api@sha256:50b647c7…`, Cloud Build, linux/amd64; job timeout raised
to 5400s, `maxRetries` 0, `SIG_OPENSTATES_KEY` binding unchanged):

- Exec `nx527` — the full 226-request sweep (56 jurisdictions × 4
  families + 2 index pages, ~50 min at the pinned 12s interval) fetched
  cleanly, then the PG sink refused the first claim with
  `claim_observed_not_future` (a bill's future-dated `latest_action_date`
  had keyed `observed_at`). `outcome=error`, `claims_added=0`, the
  violation recorded verbatim in the run row — fail-loud, append-only.
  Fixed by the no-`observed_at` design.
- Execs `jwm5f`/`clf7v` — both seed `/jurisdictions` fetches answered
  persistent HTTP 429: 12 `back_off` rate-limit events + 4 recorded
  disappearances, zero requests bypassed. The rate-limit recording path
  verified live.
- The 429 body is verbatim `exceeded limit of 250/day: 343` — the key's
  tier is 250 requests/day and today's window is exhausted (exploratory
  probes + the sweep + retries). The landing + spine delta + idempotent
  rerun are owed on the next quota window or a key-tier upgrade —
  recorded as **D-SOURCES.10-1**. The weekly cadence (226 ≤ 250/day) is
  sustainable as deployed.
